title: No longer ‘unloved’: retailers investing more in physical stores, UK data shows
summary: Knight Frank says shopping centres and food stores lead revival as retail outperforms other commercial property Shoppers shun UK high streets despite lure of Boxing Day sales UK retailers are investing more in bricks and mortar, with shopping centres and food stores leading a revival, according to research. Retailers and property investors are reallocating capital back into physical stores, according to the property group Knight Frank. Continue reading...
